we-c-econ.label: Correlation between a bowling innings' economy and winning (IPL)
we-c-econ.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
we-c-econ.filters: Bowling innings of at least ten overs, matches with a result
we-c-econ.query: SELECT m.match_id, i.bowling_team_id bo, CASE WHEN m.winner_id = i.bowling_team_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END won, SUM((d.total_runs - CASE WHEN d.is_bye = 1 OR d.is_legbye = 1 THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END)) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls, SUM(CASE WHEN dm.dismissal_id IS NOT NULL AND dm.kind NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) wk FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id LEFT JOIN dismissals dm ON dm.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND m.winner_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.match_id, i.innings_id

we-c-wk.label: Correlation between wickets taken in a bowling innings and winning (IPL)
we-c-wk.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
we-c-wk.query: SELECT m.match_id, i.bowling_team_id bo, CASE WHEN m.winner_id = i.bowling_team_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END won, SUM((d.total_runs - CASE WHEN d.is_bye = 1 OR d.is_legbye = 1 THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END)) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls, SUM(CASE WHEN dm.dismissal_id IS NOT NULL AND dm.kind NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) wk FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id LEFT JOIN dismissals dm ON dm.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND m.winner_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.match_id, i.innings_id

we-best-name.label: RCB's most economical bowler-season since 2022 (min. five wickets)
we-best-name.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
we-best-name.query: SELECT pl.name, CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, SUM((d.total_runs - CASE WHEN d.is_bye = 1 OR d.is_legbye = 1 THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END)) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls, SUM(CASE WHEN dm.dismissal_id IS NOT NULL AND dm.kind NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) wk FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = d.bowler_id LEFT JOIN dismissals dm ON dm.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND i.bowling_team_id IN (2,15) AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) >= 2022 GROUP BY pl.name, year HAVING balls >= 120
